snippet.title: New Science - Trailer
snippet.description:
Combine two cards and see what you get. Every discovery becomes a new ingredient, and if nobody has found that combination before, the card keeps your name.

Play free in your browser: https://www.newsciencegame.com

New Science is a card discovery game. Choose two or three cards, combine them, and see what comes out. Follow Targets through 16 Ages, from the Stone Age to the Age of Intelligence, or switch Target mode off and experiment with everything you own. Both use the same collection, so you can change your mind whenever you like and keep everything you have found.

Over 50,000 cards have been discovered so far. Every one is illustrated and named the moment it is found, and the first player to make a combination is recorded as its discoverer permanently. Build a collection, work through the Ages, trade with other players, and go looking for the things nobody has made yet.

ON STEAM
Play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4856510/New_Science_Demo/

Wishlist the full game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4731610/New_Science/

FOLLOW
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@New-Science-Game
X: https://x.com/agapo_dgc
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@agapo_dgc
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/discgolfcity.bsky.social
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591572153469
